_about: John Knox (c.1514-1572). Named john-knox so Vicesimus Knox and others cannot collide. The target is David Laing's Works (6 vols, Wodrow Society / Bannatyne Club, Edinburgh 1846-1864, reissued by James Thin 1895). Vols. 1-2 (the History of the Reformation) are clean proofread text from Gutenberg (PG 21938, 40886; the 1895 Thin reissue; headers checked, no COPYRIGHTED marker). Vols. 3-6 are Internet Archive OCR, raw; each title page read. Vol. 4 is the 1895 reissue (the only readable scan found); vols. 3 and 6 are the original printings (1854, 1864). CCEL's First Blast and Treatise on Prayer are held clean alongside.
